defectsSummary: 1. findStanceChain looks up dotted names (upperleg01.L) but Three.js sanitises to upperleg01L
2. Heel target sign: code adds heelToToe to desired toe; correct is desiredToe - heelToToe
3. solveTwoBoneIK returns from-identity quaternions; hip must compose with animated pose, knee must become absolute local bend
4. Collinear fallback uses hip.parent as actor frame and applyMatrix4 on direction (includes translation); must use caller-supplied actorSlot as direction-only frame
5. Max extension uses current hip-to-heel distance; must use upperLen + lowerLen
6. First arrived frame: restLocal present, closing begins false; restoreSettlingRestToePose restores rest locals, sets closing true, but wrapper returns before settled correction
7. Existing tests use identity rotations, zero heel-to-toe XZ offset, dotted names, and never import applySettledPostureCorrection directly
